description: Provider catalog. Entries are added only when a migrated Brain needs them (Repository Phase 2: Wind's three Brain-exclusive sources). Each entry: providerId, acquisitionOwner, healthOwner, authorizedConsumers, costClass, licenseRef; domainInterpreter is declared by the consumer in brain.json. Not yet registered: every other provider (inventory adoption is deliberate; TVA consolidation blocked on D8; Open-Meteo behavior unchanged).
